rule.description: Coverage thresholds are a hard gate. PRs that do not meet minimums are BLOCKED. Check coverage after every GREEN phase, not just at PR time.

enforcement.rule: Run coverage report after every GREEN step
If any threshold not met — write additional tests before proceeding
Never exclude files from coverage without comment in code AND PR description
PR description MUST include coverage table (see template below)

rule.pr-template: ## Coverage | Metric | Result | Threshold | Status | |------------|--------|-----------|--------| | Lines | xx% | 80% | ✅/❌ | | Branches | xx% | 75% | ✅/❌ | | Functions | xx% | 80% | ✅/❌ | | Statements | xx% | 80% | ✅/❌ |

violations.violation: Missing coverage table in PR description
